articles.title: Dissecting Sensitivity to Training Language in Self-Supervised Speech Learning Using Neural Audio Codec Tokens
articles.abstract: Neural audio codecs (NACs) have become popular for obtaining speech representations as discrete tokens. Beyond compression, discrete tokens can be used to train self-supervised learning (SSL) models. Such models, referred to as codec-based SSL models, reduce data storage and computational cost, enabling scalable SSL pre-training. However, their language sensitivity remains unclear. When the language changes, codec-based SSL models may require retraining, which undermines their efficiency. In this paper, we present a systematic analysis of language sensitivity by varying either the NAC training language or the SSL pre-training language while keeping the other fixed. Experimental results show that downstream performance is insensitive to the NAC training language but strongly dependent on the SSL pre-training language. These findings suggest that a single NAC can be reused across languages, while aligning the SSL pre-training language with the target language is crucial.
articles.titleCn: 解析自监督语音学习中对训练语言敏感性的神经音频编解码器标记
articles.abstractCn: 神经音频编解码器（NACs）已成为获取语音表征为离散标记的流行方法。除了压缩之外，离散标记还可以用于训练自监督学习（SSL）模型。这类模型被称为基于编解码器的SSL模型，它们减少了数据存储和计算成本，从而实现了可扩展的SSL预训练。然而，它们对语言敏感性的影响尚不明确。当语言发生变化时，基于编解码器的SSL模型可能需要重新训练，这会削弱其效率。在本文中，我们通过改变NAC训练语言或SSL预训练语言中的一个，同时保持另一个固定，对语言敏感性进行了系统分析。实验结果表明，下游性能对NAC训练语言不敏感，但强烈依赖于SSL预训练语言。这些发现表明，单个NAC可以在不同语言间复用，而将SSL预训练语言与目标语言对齐至关重要。

articles.title: When Synthetic Users Fail: A Cross-Domain Benchmark of LLM-Simulated Human Survey Responses
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic users, stand-ins for human respondents whose simulated answers feed product, policy, and market decisions. We ask when this substitution is valid and when it fails, and package the answer as an evaluation framework for intelligent synthetic-user systems. A single protocol, run across four models spanning two families and an 8B-to-frontier capability range, is applied to two independent domains of real human-response data: U.S. general social attitudes (General Social Survey) and cross-cultural values (World Values Survey). Every model is benchmarked against a suite of non-LLM baselines fit on held-out human data. Under demographic prompting and the survey-simulation protocols we test, two failures replicate across both domains, all four models, and both families. First, at the individual level no LLM beats even the strongest baseline; on cross-cultural values every model falls well below it, and the gap survives distance-aware and proper scoring. Second, models systematically over-determine demographics, treating identity as far more predictive of attitudes than it is among real people, a distortion present for nearly every question-group combination and robust to a coding-invariant measure. Neither failure is remedied by a larger, more capable model. A decision-impact analysis shows why this matters in practice: on a segment-targeting task the models inflate between-segment gaps two to fourfold, would direct a team to the wrong segment in half of U.S. and most cross-cultural cases, and manufacture segment splits that do not exist in real people. We make the cross-domain benchmark and the evaluation framework available on request, so that teams can determine in advance when synthetic-user evidence is safe for decision support and when it is not.

articles.titleCn: 当合成用户失败时：一个跨领域基准测试LLM模拟的人类调查响应
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作合成用户，作为人类受访者的替代者，其模拟答案为产品、政策和市场决策提供依据。我们探讨了这种替代何时有效、何时失效，并将答案打包为一个用于智能合成用户系统的评估框架。一个单一协议，跨越四个涵盖两个系列和8B至前沿能力范围的模型，被应用于两个独立领域的人类响应数据：美国一般社会态度（一般社会调查）和跨文化价值观（世界价值观调查）。每个模型都针对保留的人类数据集的非LLM基线进行基准测试。在人口统计提示和我们所测试的调查模拟协议下，两个失效现象在两个领域、所有四个模型和两个系列中都得到复制。首先，在个体层面，没有LLM能超越最强的基线；在跨文化价值观方面，每个模型都远低于基线，且差距在距离感知和适当评分下依然存在。其次，模型系统性地过度确定人口统计特征，将身份视为比真实人群中更可预测态度的因素，这种扭曲存在于几乎所有问题组合中，并对编码不变的度量具有鲁棒性。这两种失效现象都无法通过更大、更强大的模型来弥补。决策影响分析表明了这在实践中的重要性：在目标受众定位任务中，模型使分段间的差距扩大两到四倍，在半数美国案例和大多数跨文化案例中会将团队引向错误分段，并制造出真实人群中不存在分段差异。我们提供跨领域基准和评估框架供请求使用，以便团队能预先确定何时合成用户证据可用于决策支持，何时不可。

articles.title: Aligning LLM-Simulated and Human Examinees for Psychometric Calibration: A Cognitive Diagnostic Profiling Approach
articles.abstract: Psychometric calibration for educational tests typically requires costly human response data. Large language models (LLMs) simulated examinees offer a promising route to early calibration, but their responses are too accurate and too uniform. We propose Cognitive Diagnostic Profiling (CDP), a zero-shot framework that prompts LLMs to simulate plausible examinees with diverse cognitive profiles: binary attribute-mastery patterns are rendered as natural-language profiles and sampled under an uninformative or an informative distribution. Using the Tatsuoka fraction-subtraction dataset (536 examinees, 15 items, five attributes), we evaluated eight LLM configurations under no-profile, uninformative-CDP, and informative-CDP conditions, assessing alignment with human examinees at the ability-distribution, mastery-profile, and item-difficulty levels. CDP improved all three levels: distributional overlap rose across configurations; weighted correlations between profile-level scores and human profile expectations reached 0.92 to 0.98; and item-difficulty recovery improved in rank order and absolute alignment, most for reasoning-enabled models; in the strongest case, Gemini 3.0 Flash (Thinking), one-parameter logistic (1PL) difficulty Spearman correlations rose from 0.24 to 0.86 and 0.90 and the root-mean-square error (RMSE) fell from 6.31 to 1.30 and 0.90; the informative condition helped most where profile-level alignment was strong. CDP brings LLM-simulated examinees into closer psychometric alignment with human examinees, making them practical for operational test development.
articles.titleCn: 基于认知诊断分析对LLM模拟和人类受试者进行心理测量校准
articles.abstractCn: 教育测试的心理测量校准通常需要昂贵的人类响应数据。大型语言模型（LLM）模拟考生为早期校准提供了一条有前景的途径，但它们的响应过于准确且过于一致。我们提出了认知诊断画像（CDP），这是一个零样本框架，提示LLM模拟具有不同认知画像的合理考生：二元属性掌握模式被渲染为自然语言画像，并在无信息或信息分布下进行采样。使用Tatsuoka分数减法数据集（536名考生，15个项目，五个属性），我们在无画像、无信息CDP和信息CDP条件下评估了八种LLM配置，评估了与人类考生在能力分布、掌握画像和项目难度层面的匹配程度。CDP在三个层面都进行了改进：配置间的分布重叠度提高；画像层面的分数与人类画像期望的加权相关性达到0.92至0.98；项目难度恢复在排名顺序和绝对匹配上有所改善，推理模型改善最多；在最强案例中，Gemini 3.0 Flash（思考），一参数逻辑（1PL）难度斯皮尔曼相关性从0.24提高到0.86和0.90，均方根误差（RMSE）从6.31降至1.30和0.90；信息条件在画像层面匹配较强时帮助最大。CDP使LLM模拟考生在心理测量上更接近人类考生，使其适用于实际测试开发。

articles.title: The Confounder Trap: Treatment-Encoding Representations in Causal Inference with Text
articles.abstract: Estimating causal effects of linguistic properties from observational text is difficult because the same document can contain both the treatment of interest and the non-treatment textual attributes needed for adjustment. Existing approaches often learn representations from the full text to capture latent confounding, but when treatment status is itself encoded by words in the text, these representations can directly encode treatment. This creates a confounder trap: richer representations can make treated and control documents separable, inducing overlap violations even when the underlying causal problem satisfies overlap. We study latent text treatments that are encoded through lexicons or other treatment-defining lexical information, and propose masking-based adjustment representations that remove this lexical treatment signal before representation learning. We formalize representation-induced overlap failure, prove that deletion masking preserves overlap for bag-of-words/topic-model representations, and characterize replacement masking as a natural relaxation for large language models that hides treatment-defining tokens while preserving word order and context. Across simulations, masking improves overlap diagnostics, stabilizes treatment effect estimates, and reduces bias relative to adjustment methods that learn from the unmasked text.
articles.titleCn: 混淆因素陷阱：文本因果推理中的处理-编码表示
articles.abstractCn: 从观察性文本中估计语言特征的因果效应是困难的，因为同一文档可能同时包含目标处理和用于调整的非处理文本属性。现有方法通常从全文中学习表示以捕获潜在的混杂因素，但当处理状态本身由文本中的词语编码时，这些表示可以直接编码处理。这会形成一个混杂陷阱：更丰富的表示可以使处理组和控制组文档分离，即使底层因果问题满足重叠条件，也会导致重叠违反。我们研究通过词汇或其他定义处理的词汇信息编码的潜在文本处理，并提出基于掩码的调整表示，在表示学习之前移除这种词汇处理信号。我们形式化了表示引起的重叠失败，证明了删除掩码对于词袋/主题模型表示保留了重叠，并将替换掩码表征为大型语言模型的一种自然放松，它隐藏了定义处理的标记，同时保留了词序和上下文。在模拟中，掩码提高了重叠诊断的准确性，稳定了处理效应估计，并相对于从未掩码文本中学习调整方法减少了偏差。

articles.title: AgentGUI: An Interface for Observing and Steering Long-Running AI Agents
articles.abstract: AI agents are increasingly adept at tackling complex, long-running tasks. With the rapid surge of autonomous capabilities, human oversight is systematically lagging behind due to limited human-centered interfacing. Aiming to address this, we introduce AgentGUI, a user-friendly, locally hosted GUI for seamlessly observing and steering AI agents amid multiple concurrent, long-running sessions. AgentGUI features 1) rich agent trajectory visualizations, 2) effective manual and automated steering, and 3) integration with and coordination between open-source and frontier agent frameworks. A controlled user study demonstrates statistically significant reduction in the time it takes to identify key elements from agent traces (38% faster, p = 0.023). In a preliminary experiment, AgentGUI's automated drift prevention feature raises the task completion rate of small local agents by as high as 34pp across a 0.8B--9B model ladder (N=50 runs per model). AgentGUI is publicly available through its project website (https://agent-gui-project.github.io) and open-source repository (https://github.com/eth-medical-ai-lab/agent-gui), along with a demo video (https://youtube.com/watch?v=GSDyxN1gTF0).
articles.titleCn: AgentGUI：用于观察和引导长时间运行的AI代理的界面
articles.abstractCn: AI代理在处理复杂、长期任务方面正变得越来越熟练。随着自主能力的快速提升，由于以人为中心的接口有限，人类监督正系统性地落后。为了解决这个问题，我们推出了AgentGUI，一个用户友好、本地部署的图形界面，用于在多个并发、长期运行的会话中无缝观察和引导AI代理。AgentGUI具备以下特点：1）丰富的代理轨迹可视化；2）有效的手动和自动化引导；3）与开源及前沿代理框架的集成与协调。一项受控用户研究表明，使用AgentGUI从代理轨迹中识别关键元素的时间显著减少（速度提升38%，p=0.023）。在一项初步实验中，AgentGUI的自动漂移预防功能将小型本地代理的任务完成率在0.8B至9B模型规模范围内提高了高达34个百分点（每个模型运行50次）。AgentGUI通过其项目网站（https://agent-gui-project.github.io）、开源代码库（https://github.com/eth-medical-ai-lab/agent-gui）以及演示视频（https://youtube.com/watch?v=GSDyxN1gTF0）公开发布。

articles.title: Evaluating Prompt Scope and Demonstration Similarity in Local LLM Machine Translation
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as general-purpose translation systems, but their behavior is usually evaluated under a single prompt shape: translate one source sentence into one target language. In practice, users may ask for one target language, for several related languages at once, or for translations conditioned on examples. This paper studies prompt scope and demonstration selection as experimental variables for local LLM machine translation. We evaluate English-to-Romance and English-to-Germanic translation on the full FLORES devtest split for nine official European Union languages. We compare three local instruction-tuned LLMs, llama3.2:3b, mistral:latest, and qwen2.5:14b, against dedicated MT baselines from OPUS-MT and NLLB-200. We test zero-shot prompting and k=5 few-shot prompting with random, lexical-similarity, and embedding-similarity demonstration selection. We also compare single-target prompts with JSON-formatted family-scope prompts that request all languages in a family at once. Results show that dedicated MT systems remain strongest overall, especially for Germanic languages. Few-shot prompting helps mistral:latest and qwen2.5:14b, but hurts llama3.2:3b; embedding retrieval is best on average for the stronger LLMs, but its advantage over random and lexical examples is modest. Family-scope prompting is feasible for stronger local LLMs but exposes structured-output failures in smaller models. These findings motivate evaluating LLM translation not only by language pair and metric, but also by prompt scope, retrieval strategy, and multi-target compliance.
articles.titleCn: 评估本地LLM机器翻译中的提示范围和示例相似度
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用作通用翻译系统，但它们的行为通常在单一提示形式下进行评估：将一个源句翻译成一种目标语言。在实际应用中，用户可能要求翻译一种目标语言，或同时翻译几种相关语言，或基于示例进行条件翻译。本文研究了提示范围和示例选择作为局部LLM机器翻译的实验变量。我们在完整的FLORES开发测试集上对英语到罗曼语族和英语到日耳曼语族九种欧盟官方语言的翻译进行了评估。我们比较了三种局部指令微调LLMs：llama3.2:3b、mistral:latest和qwen2.5:14b，与OPUS-MT和NLLB-200的专用MT基线。我们测试了零样本提示和k=5少样本提示，分别采用随机、词汇相似性和嵌入相似性示例选择。我们还比较了单一目标提示与JSON格式家族范围提示，后者要求一次性请求一个家族中的所有语言。结果表明，专用MT系统总体上仍然最强，尤其是在日耳曼语族语言上。少样本提示有助于mistral:latest和qwen2.5:14b，但损害了llama3.2:3b；嵌入检索平均对更强的LLMs效果最佳，但其相对于随机和词汇示例的优势有限。家族范围提示对更强的局部LLMs是可行的，但在较小模型中暴露了结构化输出失败的问题。这些发现表明，评估LLM翻译不仅要考虑语言对和指标，还要考虑提示范围、检索策略和多目标合规性。

articles.title: Robostreet Flow: A Lightweight, Ultra-Low-Drag Electric Tractor and Four-Truck Hybrid Convoy Architecture for Minimum-Cost Point-to-Point Freight
articles.abstract: Line-haul trucking costs are dominated by three comparably sized components: energy, driver labor, and equipment. Most efficiency technologies address only one component at a time. This paper presents Robostreet Flow, a freight architecture that jointly optimizes the vehicle, convoy formation, and operating model to minimize cost per ton-mile on high-volume point-to-point corridors. The Flow platform is a battery-electric 6x4 tractor with a teardrop single-seat cab and a drag coefficient of 0.35, approximately 40% below that of conventional Class 8 tractors. A carbon-composite monocoque and structurally integrated batteries reduce net vehicle weight by 50%. A 513 kWh tractor battery and a 340 kWh powered trailer battery provide a 500-mile single-charge range. Four Flow trucks operate as a coordinated convoy with a safety driver only in the lead vehicle, while three followers operate in SAE Level 4 automated mode. Computational fluid dynamics simulations show that close following at an 8 m gap reduces follower drag coefficients by 42-48% and follower peak frontal pressure by approximately a factor of four relative to the exposed lead vehicle. A longitudinal energy model calibrated to these results predicts fleet-average consumption of 1.27 kWh/mi in convoy, compared with 1.60 kWh/mi for an isolated vehicle, for a 20.5% energy saving. Electricity cost is approximately 17% of the equivalent diesel fuel cost. Amortizing one driver across four trucks and accounting for the additional payload enabled by lightweighting reduce operating cost from 9.4 to 4.1 cents per ton-mile, a 56% reduction relative to a diesel baseline. Sensitivity analysis, a hub-to-hub operating concept, and regulatory implications are also presented.

articles.titleCn: Robostreet 流：一种轻量级、超低阻力的电动拖车与四辆卡车混合编队架构，用于最低成本点对点货运
articles.abstractCn: 线路运输成本主要由三个规模相当的组成部分构成：能源、驾驶员劳动力和设备。大多数效率技术仅针对其中一个部分进行优化。本文介绍了Robostreet Flow，这是一种货运架构，通过联合优化车辆、车队编队和运营模式，以最小化高容量点对点走廊的每吨英里成本。Flow平台是一款电池电动6x4牵引车，配备泪滴形单人驾驶舱，风阻系数为0.35，比传统8级牵引车低约40%。碳复合材料单体壳和结构集成电池将车辆净重减轻了50%。513 kWh的牵引车电池和340 kWh的拖车电池提供500英里的单次充电续航里程。四辆Flow卡车以协调编队形式运行，只有领车配备安全驾驶员，而三辆跟随车在SAE Level 4自动驾驶模式下运行。计算流体动力学模拟显示，以8米的间距紧密跟随可降低跟随车的风阻系数42-48%，并使跟随车的峰值正面压力比暴露的领车降低约四倍。根据这些结果校准的纵向能源模型预测，编队运行的平均油耗为1.27 kWh/mi，而孤立车辆为1.60 kWh/mi，节省了20.5%的能源。电力成本约为等量柴油燃料成本的17%。通过将一名驾驶员分摊到四辆卡车，并考虑轻量化带来的额外载重能力，运营成本从每吨英里9.4美分降至4.1美分，比柴油基准降低了56%。此外，本文还介绍了敏感性分析、枢纽到枢纽的运营概念以及监管影响。

articles.title: A large-scale corpus of religious radio broadcast transcripts from webstream recordings in the United States
articles.abstract: Religious radio is a widespread but understudied form of mass communication in the United States, and content-level analysis of it has been constrained by the absence of large-scale transcript data. This Data Descriptor presents a corpus of transcribed English-language religious radio broadcasts captured from live webstreams over a one-month period in July 2025. Fifteen-minute segments were recorded on a rolling schedule from 785 distinct streams, which together rebroadcast the signals of more than two thousand AM and FM stations, yielding over 700,000 recordings and more than 60 million diarized lines of speech. Each recording was transcribed and speaker-diarized with an automated pipeline, and segmented and labeled by programming format and topic using a large language model. The corpus is organized as linked tables of stream metadata, recording metadata, and transcript lines. It supports descriptive study of religious broadcasting across regions and traditions, analysis of how social and political issues are discussed in religious media, and speech-processing research in an underrepresented domain.
articles.titleCn: 美国网络直播宗教广播文稿的大型语料库
articles.abstractCn: 宗教广播是美国一种广泛存在但研究不足的大众传播形式，其内容分析因缺乏大规模文本数据而受限。本数据描述呈现了一个语料库，该语料库收录了2025年7月一个月期间从直播网络流中捕获的英语宗教广播转录内容。通过滚动时间表从785个不同流中录制了15分钟的片段，这些流共同转播了超过两千个AM和FM电台的信号，产生了超过70万条录音和超过6000万条标注对话行。每条录音都通过自动化流程进行转录和说话人标注，并使用大型语言模型按节目格式和主题进行分段和标注。语料库组织为流元数据、录音元数据和转录行之间的链接表格。它支持跨地区和传统的宗教广播描述性研究、分析宗教媒体中社会和政治问题的讨论方式，以及在代表性不足领域进行的语音处理研究。

articles.title: Steering Instruction Hierarchies at Inference Time
articles.abstract: Instruction hierarchies are a core safety assumption of language model deployment: higher priority inputs, such as system prompts, should override conflicting lower priority inputs from users or tools. Yet frontier LLMs often violate this hierarchy. We introduce V-Steer, a training-free inference time method that restores privileged influence by editing cached value vectors at prompt positions. Using direct logit attribution on the first next token prediction, V-Steer identifies heads where lower priority spans dominate privileged ones, then boosts privileged spans and suppresses conflicting lower priority spans through in-place multiplicative edits to cached V tensors. Since the method acts only on cached values, it remains compatible with fused attention backends and adds only a one time prefill overhead. Across models from 7B to 70B, this attribution guided intervention raises primary constraint accuracy from under 18% up to 92% on controlled role conflict benchmarks, and on broader instruction hierarchy evaluations substantially outperforms prompt only baselines while matching or exceeding SoTA training based methods on 3 of 4 scales of LLMs, with negligible decoding-speed overhead. The code is available at https://github.com/cindy2000sh/v-steer.
articles.comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM '26; the first two authors contributed equally to the work. 24 pages, 9 figures
articles.titleCn: 推理时的转向指令层级
articles.abstractCn: 指令层级是语言模型部署的核心安全假设：高优先级输入（如系统提示）应覆盖来自用户或工具的冲突低优先级输入。然而，前沿的大型语言模型（LLM）常常违反这一层级。我们引入了V-Steer，这是一种无需训练的推理时方法，通过编辑提示位置的缓存值向量来恢复特权影响。通过对首个下一个词预测进行直接逻辑归因，V-Steer识别出低优先级跨度主导特权跨度的头部，然后通过在缓存V张量上进行的原位乘法编辑来提升特权跨度并抑制冲突的低优先级跨度。由于该方法仅作用于缓存值，因此它保持与融合注意力后端兼容，并且仅增加一次性的预填充开销。在从7B到70B的各个模型中，这种归因指导的干预将主要约束精度在受控的角色冲突基准上从不到18%提高到92%，在更广泛的指令层级评估中，它显著优于仅提示的基线，并在LLM的4个尺度中的3个上与最先进的基于训练的方法相当或超越，解码速度开销可以忽略不计。代码可在https://github.com/cindy2000sh/v-steer获取。

articles.title: Characterizing Human-Likeness in AI Generated Poetry: A Zero-shot Classification Study
articles.abstract: With the advancement of AI technologies, Generative AI (GenAI) and human written text have become nearly indistinguishable. Additionally, the global standardization of AI chatbots made academic malpractice more frequent. Furthermore, existing research indicates GenAI poems are the most difficult to distinguish even without any modification thus, GenAI poems are naturally deemed human-like by modern detectors. However, the objectivity of such dissertations needs to be verified against modern detection tools but the subjectivity of poetry and the black-box nature of the modern LLMs (Large Language Models) architectures made verification of such work quite complicated. Hence, the main objective of the research is to deduce the attributes of English poetry that contribute classification and misclassification of both human and AI poems and provide corroborating or contradicting evidence to the poetry distinguishability claim. For such characterizations, we propose a Zero-shot detection pipeline with a dataset consisting of both human and AI poems to verify the distinguishability of human and AI creation and extract the aforementioned crucial attributes for accurate classification. Extraction of such attributes provides benefits in two ways: firstly, it reduces the margin of training needed as only the poems based on misclassifying attributes need to be trained and fine tuned and finally provides a critical insight to the GenAI detection dilemma to strengthen the modern detection pipelines.
articles.titleCn: 人工智能生成诗歌中的人性化特征：零样本分类研究
articles.abstractCn: 随着人工智能技术的进步，生成式人工智能（GenAI）与人类撰写的文本几乎无法区分。此外，全球范围内人工智能聊天机器人的标准化使得学术不端行为更加普遍。进一步的研究表明，未经任何修改的GenAI诗歌最难被识别，因此现代检测工具普遍认为GenAI诗歌具有人类特征。然而，这类论文的客观性需要通过现代检测工具进行验证，但诗歌的主观性和现代大型语言模型（LLMs）架构的黑盒特性使得此类工作的验证变得相当复杂。因此，本研究的主要目标是通过推断英语诗歌中导致人类诗歌和AI诗歌分类和误分类的属性，并提供支持或反驳诗歌可识别性主张的证据。为此，我们提出了一种零样本检测流程，其数据集包含人类诗歌和AI诗歌，以验证人类创作和AI创作的可区分性，并提取上述关键属性以实现准确分类。提取这些属性具有双重好处：首先，它减少了所需的训练范围，因为只需训练和微调基于误分类属性的诗歌；最后，它为GenAI检测困境提供了关键洞察，以加强现代检测流程。

articles.title: Choosing Where and How to Moderate: End-to-End Trade-offs in Filter Placement and Response Rewriting
articles.abstract: Content-moderation classifiers are usually evaluated in isolation, but deployment requires choosing where to intervene and what follows a flag. We evaluate these choices using two end-to-end customer-outcome metrics rather than component accuracy: Usefulness, the fraction of turns with a shown, non-harmful, relevant response, and Harmful Exposure, the fraction with a shown harmful response. Latency and error rates are diagnostics. We compare Input only, Response only, and Input + response hard blocking on a human-labelled product benchmark and public ToxicChat evaluation. At the evaluated operating points, Response only achieves the highest filter-only Usefulness in both settings, while Input + response achieves lower Harmful Exposure. Replacing Response only blocking with Response + rewrite recovers most blocked traffic and yields the same observed Harmful Exposure count as Response only blocking for the selected configuration; this equality is not an equivalence result. Probe routing substantially reduces conditional route-and-generation time relative to LLM routing at comparable measured outcomes. A focused output review shows how rewrites balance filter passage with usefulness by generalizing triggering language while retaining benign intent and safe redirection; some sensitive-domain outputs nevertheless omit potentially safety-relevant support information. These results support comparing moderation configurations under deployment-specific safety and latency constraints rather than applying a universal placement rule. Code and public artifacts are available at https://github.com/microsoft/mod-frontier
articles.titleCn: 选择在哪里以及如何进行审核：过滤器放置和响应重写的端到端权衡
articles.abstractCn: 内容审核分类器通常独立评估，但部署时需要选择干预点以及标记后的后续处理。我们使用两种端到端客户效果指标来评估这些选择，而非组件准确率：有用性，即显示非有害且相关的回复的比例；有害暴露，即显示有害回复的比例。延迟和错误率是诊断指标。我们在人类标注的产品基准和公共的ToxicChat评估中比较了仅输入、仅回复和输入+回复硬阻断。在评估的操作点，仅回复在两种环境下均实现了最高的纯过滤有用性，而输入+回复实现了较低的有害暴露。用回复+重写替换仅回复阻断可恢复大部分被阻断流量，并在选定配置下产生与仅回复阻断相同的观察到的有害暴露计数；这种相等性并非等价结果。与LLM路由相比，探测路由在同等测量结果下显著减少了条件路由和生成时间。聚焦输出审查显示，重写通过泛化触发语言、保留良性意图和安全重定向来平衡过滤通过和有用性；但某些敏感领域输出仍遗漏了潜在安全相关信息。这些结果支持在特定的安全和延迟约束下比较部署中的审核配置，而非应用通用放置规则。代码和公共工件可在https://github.com/microsoft/mod-frontier获取。

articles.title: Position: Evaluation Scores Are Perishable Knowledge Claims

authors.name: Shlok Gilda
authors.affiliation: human evaluation provides stronger evidence than an automated metric

articles.abstract: Evaluation methodologies for language models increasingly combine multiple signals, from automated metrics and LLM-as-judge ratings to human assessments and benchmark suite results. When these signals are aggregated via averaging, evaluation confidence can then substantially exceed the reliability of the weakest signal: a phenomenon we call trust inflation in evaluation. We argue that evaluation scores should be treated as epistemic claims with three properties: formality (human evaluation provides stronger evidence than an automated metric), scope (a benchmark result applies to the tested distribution, not universally), and validity windows (benchmark results expire as contamination accumulates and distributions shift). Several converging research traditions (chain-of-thought analysis, possibilistic logic, and algebraic theory) establish weakest-link aggregation as the conservative endpoint of a parameterized operator family controlled by a single pessimism parameter. Drawing on those traditions, and on concrete lessons from building an evaluation harness for agentic AI, we propose that evaluation results carry explicit metadata (formality tier, scope declaration, and expiration date) to make their epistemic status transparent. We illustrate the cost of mean aggregation on the public HELM leaderboard: across 54 frontier models on ten scenarios, the top-five models ranked by mean score and by weakest-link are completely disjoint.
articles.comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Published at the Fifth Workshop on Generation, Evaluation and Metrics (GEM), ACL 2026, San Diego
articles.titleCn: 职位：评估分数是会过时的知识主张
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型的评估方法越来越多地结合多种信号，从自动化指标和大型语言模型作为评判者评分到人工评估和基准套件结果。当这些信号通过平均方式聚合时，评估的置信度可以显著超过最弱信号的可靠性：我们称之为评估中的信任膨胀现象。我们认为评估分数应被视为具有三种属性的认知主张：正式性（人工评估比自动化指标提供更强的证据）、范围（基准结果适用于被测试的分布，而非普遍适用）以及有效性窗口（基准结果会随着污染的积累和分布的变动而失效）。几种趋同的研究传统（思维链分析、可能性逻辑和代数理论）确立了最弱链聚合作为受单一悲观参数控制的参数化算子家族的保守终点。借鉴这些传统，并结合构建自主AI评估框架的具体经验教训，我们提出评估结果应包含明确的元数据（正式性层级、范围声明和失效日期），以使其认知状态透明化。我们通过公共HELMS排行榜说明了平均聚合的成本：在十个场景下的54个前沿模型中，按平均分排名前五的模型和按最弱链排名前五的模型完全不同。

articles.title: Cognitive Convergence: Deep Similarities Between Large Language Models and Human Cognition
articles.abstract: LLMs are widely regarded as alien intelligences, systems whose cognitive operations are fundamentally unlike our own. Apparent similarities to human cognition are therefore often seen as the result of anthropomorphic projection. We argue that this framing is mistaken. LLMs clearly differ from humans in important respects, including their physical substrate, learning history, and the environments with which they interact. These differences make it all the more striking that contemporary LLM-based systems converge with human cognition on a number of principles of cognitive organization with longstanding support in cognitive science. We identify structural correspondences across five dimensions: inferential organization, computational architecture, representational structure, prediction-driven learning, and reinforcement-learning-like mechanisms supporting goal-directed action. These correspondences support a broader model of intelligent cognition in which core principles long used to explain human intelligence also characterize contemporary LLM-based systems.
articles.titleCn: 认知趋同：大型语言模型与人类认知的深层相似性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型被广泛视为外星智能，其认知操作与人类根本不同。因此，它们与人类认知的表面相似性常被视为拟人化投射的结果。我们认为这种框架是错误的。大型语言模型在物理基质、学习历史以及交互环境等方面与人类存在明显差异。这些差异使得当代基于大型语言模型系统的认知组织原则与人类认知在认知科学中长期得到支持的多个原则上趋同这一现象更加引人注目。我们在五个维度上识别了结构对应性：推理组织、计算架构、表征结构、预测驱动学习和支持目标导向行动的强化学习类机制。这些对应性支持了一种更广泛的人工智能认知模型，其中长期用于解释人类智能的核心原则也体现在当代基于大型语言模型系统中。

articles.title: DuplexGen: Adaptive Synthesis of Human-AI Turn-Taking Dialogues
articles.abstract: Turn-taking is a central component of full-duplex interaction. Which turn-taking behaviors are appropriate varies with the scenario, yet current models apply a single norm regardless of context. This limitation originates in their training data: human-human speech corpora capture natural timing phenomena but provide little role grounding or scenario-specific norms, while heuristic or prompted synthesis methods inject turn-taking behaviors without basing them on human preferences. We introduce DuplexGen, a framework for generating dialogues with scenario-adaptive turn-taking by calibrating LLM predictions against a small set of slot-level human preference annotations. In six cooperative and competitive tasks, human turn-taking preferences differ systematically, and DuplexGen aligns substantially more closely with those preferences than uncalibrated prompting or training solely on generic human-human data; a full-duplex model trained on DuplexGen-generated data exhibits distinctive, human-preferred turn-taking behaviors. These results show that human calibration, not corpus scale or prompt design alone, is what allows turn-taking synthesis to be scenario-specific.
articles.titleCn: DuplexGen：自适应生成人类-人工智能轮流对话
articles.abstractCn: 轮流发言是全双工交互的核心组成部分。适当的轮流发言行为因场景而异，然而当前模型无论何种情境都应用单一规范。这一局限性源于其训练数据：人类对话语音语料库捕捉了自然的时序现象，但缺乏角色基础或场景特定规范，而启发式或提示合成方法则在不基于人类偏好的情况下注入轮流发言行为。我们引入了DuplexGen框架，通过将大语言模型预测与少量槽位级人类偏好标注进行校准，生成具有场景自适应轮流发言的对话。在六个合作与竞争任务中，人类的轮流发言偏好存在系统性差异，DuplexGen与这些偏好的吻合程度远超未校准的提示或仅基于通用人类对话数据进行训练；在DuplexGen生成的数据上训练的全双工模型展现出独特且符合人类偏好的轮流发言行为。这些结果表明，人类校准而非语料库规模或提示设计本身，才是使轮流发言合成具有场景特定性的关键。

articles.title: Pass the Baton: Trajectory-Relayed On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) grounds token-level supervision in the student's own trajectory, yet suffers from prefix failure: once the student commits to a wrong reasoning direction, all subsequent generation builds on this deviation, producing misdirected continuations that elicit unreliable supervision and waste compute. We identify a teacher-student continuation asymmetry on failed prefixes, where the teacher tends to redirect while the student continues along the original direction, and convert it into a label-free handoff trigger in Relay On-Policy Distillation (Relay-OPD). During training, Relay-OPD constructs relay trajectories by letting the teacher briefly take over at detected trigger points to produce a teacher leg, after which the student resumes and is optimized on the resulting trajectory. A limited relay budget concentrates intervention on critical early positions while limiting departure from the student policy. With a Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 teacher and Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B-Non-Thinking students on eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks, Relay-OPD achieves the best or second-best results on every benchmark, outperforming standard OPD by +5.73% and the strongest baseline FastOPD by +1.49% on average for 1.7B, with consistent gains at 0.6B. Training trajectory length is reduced by over 50%.
articles.titleCn: 传递接力棒：基于轨迹中继的在线策略蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）将标记级监督建立在学生的自身轨迹上，但存在前缀失败问题：一旦学生选择错误的推理方向，后续生成都会基于这一偏差，产生误导性的延续，从而引发不可靠的监督并浪费计算资源。我们识别出在失败前缀上存在的师生延续不对称性，即教师倾向于重新引导，而学生则沿原方向继续，并将其转化为无标签的交接触发器，应用于Relay On-Policy Distillation（Relay-OPD）。在训练过程中，Relay-OPD通过让教师短暂接管在检测到的触发点生成教师轨迹，然后学生恢复并基于该轨迹进行优化，构建交接轨迹。有限的交接预算将干预集中在关键的早期位置，同时限制偏离学生策略的程度。在数学推理的八个基准测试上，使用Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507教师和Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B-Non-Thinking学生，Relay-OPD在所有基准测试中均取得最佳或次优结果，平均而言，在1.7B模型上比标准OPD提升5.73%，比最强的基线FastOPD提升1.49%，在0.6B模型上同样取得持续提升，训练轨迹长度减少超过50%。

articles.title: Probing the Origins of Reasoning Performance: Representational Quality for Mathematical Problem-Solving in RL vs. SFT Fine-Tuned Models
articles.abstract: Large reasoning models trained via reinforcement learning (RL) have been increasingly shown to outperform their supervised fine-tuned (SFT) counterparts on mathematical reasoning tasks; Yet the mechanistic basis for this advantage remains unclear. We therefore ask, what internal representational differences enable RL models' superior performance? Our work presents two converging lines of evidence: First, linear probes trained on layer-wise hidden states reveal that RL models tend to achieve higher accuracy in predicting answer correctness compared to SFT models, indicating more linearly separable and structured representations. Second, mean ablation studies show that RL models develop a hierarchical architecture where deeper layers become progressively more critical, whereas SFT models distribute importance uniformly across layers. Together, these findings demonstrate that RL training fundamentally restructures how models represent and process reasoning problems. Finally, we analyze token-count variability under repeated sampling across problems to assess adaptive compute allocation. While we observe higher variability in some RL-tuned models than in their SFT counterparts, we see strong consistency in others, suggesting that token allocation may depend more on the overall training pipeline than on RL versus SFT alone. We believe this token-allocation variability reveals the spread of plausible on-policy reasoning, highlighting which models exhibit stable policies versus those that are under-determined, potentially non-identifiable solution behaviour.
articles.titleCn: 探究推理表现起源：强化学习与自监督学习微调模型在数学问题解决中的表征质量
articles.abstractCn: 通过强化学习（RL）训练的大型推理模型在数学推理任务上越来越显示出优于其监督微调（SFT）对应模型的表现；然而，这种优势的机制基础仍然不清楚。因此，我们提出问题：哪些内部表征差异使RL模型的性能更优越？我们的研究呈现了两条相互印证的证据：首先，在逐层隐藏状态上训练的线性探针揭示，与SFT模型相比，RL模型在预测答案正确性上往往能获得更高的准确率，表明其表征更线性可分且结构化；其次，平均消融研究表明，RL模型发展出一种分层架构，其中更深层的部分变得越来越关键，而SFT模型则在整个层级间均匀分配重要性。综合这些发现表明，RL训练从根本上重塑了模型表征和处理推理问题的方式。最后，我们分析了在重复采样过程中不同问题上的token计数变化，以评估自适应计算分配。虽然我们观察到某些RL微调模型的token计数变化比其SFT对应模型更大，但其他模型则显示出高度一致性，这表明token分配可能更多地依赖于整体训练流程，而不仅仅是RL与SFT的选择。我们认为这种token分配的变异性揭示了策略推理的分布范围，突显了哪些模型表现出稳定策略，而哪些模型则存在不确定或难以识别的解决方案行为。

articles.title: UniMem: Complementary Episodic-to-Parametric Memory for Boundary-Agnostic Task Streams
articles.abstract: Memory is essential for LLM agents to accumulate task experience and reuse task-specific execution strategies. However, real-world deployment over boundary-agnostic and evolving task streams exposes a fundamental stability-plasticity dilemma. External retrieval-based memory can rapidly absorb new evidence, but it often fails to internalize recurring execution patterns and incurs inference-time retrieval overhead. Parametric memory enables stable and efficient execution once learned, but typically relies on explicit task boundaries and fixed parameter budgets. Inspired by the human brain, which balances plasticity and stability through complementary episodic storage and gradual consolidation, we propose UniMem, a self-routing framework for autonomous memory management. UniMem uses learnable routing tokens as memory controllers, enabling adaptive coordination between complementary memory pathways: novel or sparse tasks are retained in an episodic buffer for retrieval-augmented execution, while recurring and reliable patterns are consolidated into expandable parametric memory. By decoupling task identification from task execution with routing tokens and parametric memory blocks, UniMem expands memory on demand without task labels during deployment or uncontrolled parameter growth. Experiments on long-horizon streaming task sequences show that UniMem consistently outperforms baselines while maintaining execution fidelity, achieving an average gain of 4.0 EM points across three backbone models.
articles.titleCn: UniMem：适用于边界无关任务流的互补式情景到参数式记忆
articles.abstractCn: 记忆对于LLM智能体积累任务经验并复用特定任务的执行策略至关重要。然而，在实际部署中，面对无边界且不断变化的任务流，会暴露出根本性的稳定性与可塑性困境。外部检索式记忆能快速吸收新证据，但往往无法内化重复的执行模式，并产生推理时的检索开销。参数式记忆在学习后能实现稳定高效的执行，但通常依赖于明确的任务边界和固定的参数预算。受人类大脑平衡可塑性与稳定性（通过互补的事件存储和渐进式巩固）的启发，我们提出了UniMem，一个用于自主记忆管理的自路由框架。UniMem使用可学习的路由标记作为记忆控制器，实现互补记忆通路间的自适应协调：新颖或稀疏的任务被保存在事件缓冲区中用于增强式执行，而重复且可靠的模式则被巩固到可扩展的参数式记忆中。通过路由标记和参数式记忆模块将任务识别与任务执行解耦，UniMem在部署或不受控的参数增长过程中无需任务标签即可按需扩展记忆。在长时序流式任务序列上的实验表明，UniMem始终优于基线模型，同时保持执行保真度，在三个主干模型上平均提升4.0 EM分。

articles.title: Instruction-Tuned Models Locally Reuse Human Syntax More Than Humans Do
articles.abstract: Syntactic convergence (the tendency of speakers to adapt in language towards the grammatical profiles of their interlocutors) is a well-documented feature of human dialogue widely considered to operate below conscious awareness. Whether large language models exhibit analogous syntactic convergence toward human users relative to human baselines and across a broad range of syntactic constructions remains an open question. Using substitution-paradigm data in which model generations replace one speaker's turns in pre-existing human dialogues, this study measures turn-adjacent reuse of context-free grammar (CFG) rules across sixteen open-weight Llama and Gemma models (1B-70B, pretrained and instruction-tuned) at 1,901 matched positions per model. Every model showed greater CFG-rule overlap with the preceding human turn than with a sampled unrelated human prime, and in every model this actual-versus-random difference was larger for lower-frequency rules. Each instruction-tuned model also showed greater natural-output overlap with the actual prime than the human response it replaced, and all eight matched architecture pairs exhibited greater actual-prime overlap after instruction tuning. However, relative to pretrained variants, instruction-tuned outputs overlapped more with unrelated primes, showed a smaller actual-versus-random increment, and had lower conditional rule-reuse odds once target rule-set size was held constant. In exploratory analyses, each model exhibited greater mean lexical and semantic similarity to the preceding turn than the matched human responses did. Instruction-tuned models additionally produced responses with greater mean semantic similarity than their pretrained counterparts in all eight architecture pairs, whereas the lexical similarity results were more heterogeneous.
articles.titleCn: 指令微调模型比人类更频繁地本地重用人类语法
articles.abstractCn: 句法趋同（即说话者为适应对话对象的语法特征而调整语言的趋势）是人类对话中一个得到充分证实的特征，通常被认为在无意识层面运作。大型语言模型是否相对于人类基线，并在广泛的句法结构范围内表现出类似的人类句法趋同，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。本研究使用替换范式数据，其中模型生成的对话替换了现有人类对话中某个说话者的回合，测量了在十六个开放权重Llama和Gemma模型（1B-70B，预训练和指令微调）的1,901个匹配位置上，上下文无关文法（CFG）规则的回合相邻重用情况。每个模型都显示出比样本无关的人类提示更高的CFG规则重叠度，并且在每个模型中，这种实际与随机的差异在低频规则中更大。每个指令微调模型也显示出比被替换的人类回复更高的自然输出重叠度，并且所有八对匹配架构在指令微调后都表现出更高的实际提示重叠度。然而，相对于预训练版本，指令微调的输出与无关提示的重叠度更高，实际与随机的增量更小，并且在目标规则集大小保持不变时，条件规则重用概率更低。在探索性分析中，每个模型都显示出比匹配人类回复更高的平均词汇和语义相似度。指令微调模型在所有八对架构中产生的回复在平均语义相似度上高于其预训练版本，而词汇相似度结果则更为多样化。

articles.title: Detecting Knowledge Inconsistencies Across Text, Tables, and Knowledge Graphs
articles.abstract: Wikipedia and Wikidata are widely used for information access, LLM pre-training, and retrieval-augmented generation. Their knowledge is deeply connected but scattered across text, tables, and knowledge graphs. This raises a practical question: when these modalities disagree, how can we detect and explain the conflict? We study this problem as modality-level inconsistency detection. We first introduce a taxonomy of cross-modal knowledge inconsistencies, covering information granularity differences, direct conflicts, temporal changes, and KG incompleteness. We then present Kontrast, an automatic framework that uses Text-to-SPARQL and LLM reasoning to compare table-based answers with KG evidence and categorize the resulting inconsistencies. Experiments on various Table-QA datasets show that cross-modal inconsistencies are common and informative. They reveal not only true knowledge conflicts, but also missing KG structure and temporal mismatches while being limited by Text-to-SPARQL errors and noise. Our analysis shows that text, tables, and KGs can complement and correct one another through systematic comparison. Kontrast provides a practical tool for large-scale knowledge auditing and establishes a benchmark for future work on cross-modal knowledge consistency. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ECLADATTA/KONTRAST.
articles.titleCn: 跨文本、表格和知识图谱的知识不一致性检测
articles.abstractCn: 维基百科和维基数据被广泛用于信息获取、大语言模型预训练和检索增强生成。它们的知识深度关联但分散在文本、表格和知识图谱中。这引发了一个实际问题：当这些模态存在分歧时，我们如何检测和解释冲突？我们将此问题研究为模态级不一致性检测。我们首先引入了一种跨模态知识不一致性的分类体系，涵盖了信息粒度差异、直接冲突、时间变化和知识图谱不完整性。然后，我们提出了Kontrast，一个自动化的框架，该框架利用文本到SPARQL转换和大语言模型推理来比较基于表格的答案与知识图谱证据，并对产生的不一致性进行分类。在多个表格问答数据集上的实验表明，跨模态不一致性是普遍且具有信息价值的。它们不仅揭示了真正的知识冲突，还暴露了知识图谱结构缺失和时间不匹配问题，但同时也受限于文本到SPARQL转换错误和噪声的影响。我们的分析表明，通过系统性的比较，文本、表格和知识图谱可以相互补充和纠正。Kontrast为大规模知识审计提供了一种实用工具，并为未来跨模态知识一致性研究建立了基准。代码和数据可在https://github.com/ECLADATTA/KONTRAST获取。

articles.title: Polistemics: Evaluating LLMs as Information Mediators in Politics & Elections

authors.name: Kevin O'Sullivan
authors.affiliation: pinned providers, reasoning-enabled judges, modal Impartiality verdicts

articles.abstract: As LLMs increasingly shape the political information citizens rely on, no standard exists to assess whether they do so responsibly. We introduce Polistemics, a theory-grounded diagnostic benchmark for evaluating LLMs as mediators of political information in elections. Prior work has treated this task as reproduction rather than mediation, leaving its epistemic dimensions and interaction with imperfect information unaddressed. We ground the evaluation in Epistemic Modesty, a normative standard derived from citizens' epistemic agency, and test it across controlled settings that vary the clarity, noise, and consistency of the available evidence. Applying the benchmark to three state-of-the-art LLMs across the 2025 German and Dutch elections, we find that high aggregate scores mask systematic failures. Models mediate reliably under clear evidence but break down when it is absent, vague, or contradictory, while flattening the intensity of political language throughout. These failures point to party priors, shifting with party labels and output language. Reliable mediation appears achievable, but no model delivers it consistently.

articles.titleCn: 政治传播学：评估大型语言模型在政治与选举中的信息中介作用
articles.abstractCn: 随着大语言模型日益影响公民依赖的政治信息，目前尚无标准来评估它们是否负责任地发挥作用。我们提出了Polistemics理论，这是一个基于理论的诊断基准，用于评估大语言模型在选举中作为政治信息中介的角色。以往的研究将这一任务视为复制而非中介，忽视了其认知维度以及与不完美信息的交互。我们将评估基于认知谦逊这一规范标准，该标准源自公民的认知能动性，并在不同清晰度、噪音和一致性变化的证据控制环境下进行测试。将基准应用于2025年德国和荷兰选举中的三个最先进的大语言模型，我们发现高综合评分掩盖了系统性缺陷。模型在清晰证据下可靠地发挥作用，但在证据缺失、模糊或矛盾时则崩溃，同时在整个过程中削弱了政治语言的强度。这些缺陷指向了与政党先验相关的变化，这些先验随着政党标签和输出语言而变化。可靠的调解似乎是可以实现的，但没有模型能够始终如一地做到这一点。

articles.title: A Cost-Effective Multimodal LLM Reasoning Framework for Question Answering over Irregular Clinical Time Series
articles.abstract: Question answering (QA) over irregular clinical time series (ICTS) plays a pivotal role in a wide range of healthcare applications. Although recent multimodal time-series large language models (LLMs) have shown considerable promise in general-purpose time-series QA, they remain poorly equipped to model the sparsity, asynchrony, and irregular sampling patterns of clinical observations. To fill this gap, we propose ClinPRISM, a cost-effective multimodal LLM reasoning framework for question answering over ICTS data. First, we devise an irregularity-aware multi-scale encoder to capture sparse clinical evidence at diverse temporal scales. Then, we propose a temporal evidence distiller to integrate representations across these scales and compress them into a small number of LLM-compatible tokens. Moreover, we introduce a progressive alignment strategy that sequentially aligns the irregular trajectories with the LLM's textual embedding space. To facilitate training, we construct 30,000 clinical time series paired with multi-scale descriptions, together with 41,000 instruction-tuning instances spanning 11 tasks. Using a 4-billion-parameter LLM backbone, ClinPRISM achieves state-of-the-art performance on the held-out evaluation benchmark while using only 16 time-series tokens and achieving an average inference latency of 0.15 seconds per question.
articles.titleCn: 一个用于处理不规则临床时间序列问答的成本效益多模态LLM推理框架
articles.abstractCn: 在非规则临床时间序列（ICTS）上的问答（QA）在广泛的医疗应用中发挥着关键作用。尽管最近的多模态时间序列大型语言模型（LLM）在通用时间序列QA方面显示出相当大的潜力，但它们仍然难以建模临床观察的稀疏性、异步性和不规则采样模式。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ClinPRISM，这是一个经济高效的多模态LLM推理框架，用于在ICTS数据上进行问答。首先，我们设计了一个不规则性感知的多尺度编码器，以在不同的时间尺度上捕获稀疏的临床证据。然后，我们提出了一种时间证据蒸馏器，以整合这些尺度上的表示，并将它们压缩成少量与LLM兼容的标记。此外，我们引入了一种渐进式对齐策略，该策略依次将不规则轨迹与LLM的文本嵌入空间对齐。为了便于训练，我们构建了30,000个带有多尺度描述的临床时间序列，以及涵盖11个任务的41,000个指令微调实例。使用一个拥有400亿参数的LLM主干，ClinPRISM在保留的评估基准上实现了最先进的性能，同时仅使用16个时间序列标记，并实现了每题平均推理延迟0.15秒。

articles.title: Evaluating Multi-Turn Multimodal Diagnostic Reasoning on Challenging Real-World Clinical Cases
articles.abstract: Clinical diagnostic evaluation should not only assess whether models can provide correct diagnoses, but also reflect the realities of clinical practice, including progressive disclosure of multimodal information, dynamic updating of diagnostic hypotheses, and continuous refinement of clinical reasoning. However, existing evaluations of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically rely on single-turn or isolated tasks, making it difficult to fully capture the complexity of real-world clinical diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we developed ClinMM-Bench, the largest multi-turn multimodal clinical diagnostic evaluation benchmark to date. ClinMM-Bench contains 1,089 challenging real-world clinical cases and 3,760 medical images across eight specialties. We systematically evaluated 15 representative MLLMs using a two-level evaluation framework that assessed both diagnostic accuracy and diagnostic reasoning quality. Results showed that proprietary models achieved the highest overall diagnostic accuracy, but the proportion of completely correct diagnoses remained limited across all models. In terms of diagnostic reasoning quality, current models can identify plausible diagnostic directions but still have considerable limitations in generating reliable diagnostic reasoning. Error analysis further identified five representative failure modes: information synthesis failure, knowledge mapping error, perception error, premature closure, and visual hallucination.
articles.titleCn: 评估多轮多模态诊断推理在具有挑战性的真实世界临床案例中的表现
articles.abstractCn: 临床诊断评估不应仅评估模型能否提供正确诊断，还应反映临床实践的实际情况，包括多模态信息的逐步披露、诊断假设的动态更新以及临床推理的持续完善。然而，现有的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）评估通常依赖于单轮或孤立任务，难以全面捕捉现实临床诊断的复杂性。为弥补这一差距，我们开发了ClinMM-Bench，这是迄今为止规模最大的多轮多模态临床诊断评估基准。ClinMM-Bench包含1089个具有挑战性的真实临床案例和3760张跨八个专科的医学影像。我们采用双层评估框架，系统评估了15个代表性MLLM，评估了诊断准确性和诊断推理质量。结果显示，专有模型实现了最高的整体诊断准确率，但所有模型中完全正确的诊断比例仍然有限。在诊断推理质量方面，当前模型能够识别可能的诊断方向，但在生成可靠的诊断推理方面仍存在相当大的局限性。错误分析进一步确定了五种代表性失效模式：信息综合失败、知识映射错误、感知错误、过早闭合和视觉幻觉。

articles.title: GPT-Red: Automated Red Teaming via Self-Play at Scale
articles.abstract: We introduce \textbf{GPT-Red}, an automated red-teaming agent that is trained to discover novel prompt injection attacks against frontier LLMs. The goal of this model is to evaluate and improve the robustness of our production systems. To this end, we use it to adversarially train GPT-5.6, our most robust model to prompt injections to date. To create GPT-Red, we design a scalable self-play algorithm where the model is tasked with attacking a diverse population of simultaneously-trained defender agents. We train the model on realistic red-teaming environments using compute on the same scale as some of our largest RL post-training runs, making it the single-largest LLM safety training run ever documented. GPT-Red excels at red-teaming: it reliably breaks our past models up to GPT-5.5, it finds more successful attacks than human red-teamers, and it generalizes to held-out environments, defender models, and harnesses. In the future, we expect that as we improve the robustness of each new GPT model, it will in turn will provide better learning signal for \textit{even stronger} red-teamer agents, thus unlocking a self-improvement flywheel.

articles.titleCn: GPT-Red：大规模自我博弈驱动的自动化红队演练
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了 \textbf{GPT-Red}，这是一个经过训练的自动化红队代理，旨在发现针对前沿大语言模型（LLMs）的新型提示注入攻击。该模型的目标是评估并提升我们生产系统的鲁棒性。为此，我们使用它对 GPT-5.6 进行对抗性训练，这是迄今为止我们对提示注入最鲁棒的模型。为了创建 GPT-Red，我们设计了一种可扩展的自博弈算法，其中模型的任务是攻击一组同时训练的防御代理。我们使用与部分最大规模的强化学习后训练运行相当的计算资源，在真实的红队环境中训练该模型，使其成为有记录以来规模最大的 LLM 安全训练运行。GPT-Red 在红队任务中表现出色：它可靠地攻破了我们过去的模型直至 GPT-5.5，其发现的成功攻击比人类红队成员更多，并且能够泛化到未知的红队环境、防御模型和利用方式。未来，我们预计随着每个新 GPT 模型的鲁棒性提升，它反过来将为 \textit{更强大的} 红队代理提供更好的学习信号，从而解锁自我改进的飞轮。

articles.title: Minimizing Targeted Activations: Input-Only Suppression of Evaluation-Awareness Latents in Large Language Models

authors.name: Samarth Agarwal
authors.affiliation: GCG-style token optimization plus a self-cross-entropy fluency regularizer, swept over a fluency weight

articles.abstract: Activation steering controls model behavior by editing internal activations at inference time. We study its input-side dual: optimizing a fluent prompt so that a chosen internal latent is driven toward zero, with no inference-time model access. Our target is an "evaluation-awareness" latent-linearly readable and steerable in recent work-whose control would threaten the validity of safety evaluations if models behave differently when they detect being tested. Adapting Fluent Dreaming / EPO with a negated feature term (GCG-style token optimization plus a self-cross-entropy fluency regularizer, swept over a fluency weight), we suppress the latent under five target constructions-a CAA direction, a subspace norm, an SAE feature, a single MLP neuron, and a behavioral logit-on Llama-3.2-3B and Llama-3.1-8B. The latent is robustly suppressible ($z\approx-7$), and a causally-validated Llama Scope SAE feature can be fully and selectively turned off. But our controls tell a cautionary story about the CAA direction: a placebo random direction is suppressed just as hard and shifts behavior just as far, and when we hold a real eval passage in context and optimize only a prefix, suppressing the eval-direction fails to reduce-and slightly increases-the model's behavioral eval judgment. Activation-readability, in short, is not behavioral controllability. We further find that a single MLP neuron is eval-correlated but not causal at both scales, and that scanning the real Pile yields a natural-text baseline competitive with the optimizer for the internal direction. A positive control validates our erasure detector, bounding an erasure-vs-rotation question earlier left open.
articles.titleCn: 最小化目标激活：仅输入抑制大型语言模型中的评估意识隐层
articles.abstractCn: 激活引导通过在推理时编辑内部激活来控制模型行为。我们研究其输入端的对偶：优化流畅提示，使选定的内部潜空间驱动向零，且无需推理时模型访问。我们的目标是“评估感知”潜线性可读且可引导的潜空间——若模型在被检测时行为不同，其控制将威胁安全评估的有效性。通过在 Fluent Dreaming / EPO 中添加否定特征项（GCG 风格的 token 优化加上自交叉熵流畅正则化，并在流畅权重上滑动），我们在 Llama-3.2-3B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 上抑制了五个目标构造下的潜空间——一个 CAA 方向、一个子空间范数、一个 SAE 特征、一个单 MLP 神经元以及一个行为逻辑位。该潜空间稳健可抑制（$z\approx-7$），并且一个因果验证的 Llama Scope SAE 特征可以被完全且选择性地关闭。但我们的控制实验揭示了 CAA 方向的警示故事：一个安慰剂随机方向被抑制得同样强烈，行为变化也同样显著，而当我们在上下文中保留真实评估段落并仅优化前缀时，抑制评估方向不仅未能减少，反而略微增加了模型的行为评估判断。简而言之，激活可读性并非行为可控性。我们进一步发现，单个 MLP 神经元在两个尺度上都与评估相关但非因果，扫描真实 Pile 得到的自然文本基线与优化器在内部方向上的表现具有竞争力。一个正向控制验证了我们的擦除检测器，解决了先前悬而未决的擦除与旋转问题。

articles.title: RSIBench-Data: Benchmarking Data-Centric Research for Recursive Self-Improvement
articles.abstract: Recursive self-improvement requires turning evidence of model failures into better models. Data-centric post-training research entails diagnosing capability gaps, designing and validating training-data strategies, and learning from checkpoint feedback. Can LLM agents automate this loop? Existing benchmarks entangle research decisions with optimization, serving, evaluation, and systems implementation, obscuring agents' research capability. We introduce RSIBench-Data, a controlled benchmark of LLM agents as data-centric researchers with a fixed post-training stack. Agents iteratively revise training-data strategies for a fixed target model; training and serving use Tinker-backed services, official evaluation runs through Harbor and E2B sandboxes, and budgets are fixed across agents. We evaluate four frontier agents on six benchmarks across software engineering, terminal use, scientific question answering, and mathematics. Agents demonstrate core data-centric research capabilities: in 58.33\% of settings, they improve upon the first valid attempt by refining strategies from feedback. However, improvement is inconsistent. Among searches continuing after the best observed score, 78.26\% end with a lower-scoring final attempt, while the rest only recover the same peak. A strong candidate may therefore appear early or midway through a run even as later revisions fail. Trajectory analysis identifies four patterns in stronger runs: accurate hypotheses, validation-grounded supervision, behavior-aligned data, and preservation of strong checkpoints. These findings suggest that current agents can make useful data-centric discoveries but cannot yet translate feedback into consistent improvements. RSIBench-Data provides a measurable, auditable testbed for the research capabilities required for recursive self-improvement. We open-source our code at https://github.com/evolvent-ai/RSIBench-Data.
articles.titleCn: RSIBench-Data：递归自我改进的数据中心研究基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 递归自我改进需要将模型失败的证据转化为更好的模型。以数据为中心的培训后研究包括诊断能力差距、设计和验证训练数据策略，以及从检查点反馈中学习。LLM代理能否自动化这个循环？现有的基准将研究决策与优化、服务、评估和系统实现纠缠在一起，掩盖了代理的研究能力。我们引入RSIBench-Data，这是一个受控基准，用于评估LLM代理作为以数据为中心的研究者，并使用固定的培训后堆栈。代理迭代地修订固定目标模型的训练数据策略；培训和提供服务使用Tinker支持的系统，官方评估通过Harbor和E2B沙盒进行，并且代理的预算是固定的。我们在软件工程、终端使用、科学问答和数学六个基准上评估了四个前沿代理。代理展示了核心的数据中心研究能力：在58.33%的情况下，它们通过从反馈中改进策略来超越第一次有效的尝试。然而，改进是不一致的。在继续搜索最佳观察分数后，78.26%的搜索以较低分数的最终尝试结束，而其余的仅恢复相同的峰值。因此，一个强有力的候选者可能出现在运行早期或中途，即使后来的修订失败。轨迹分析在更强的运行中确定了四种模式：准确的假设、基于验证的监督、行为对齐的数据和保留强检查点。这些发现表明，当前的代理可以进行有用的数据中心发现，但目前还不能将反馈转化为持续改进。RSIBench-Data为递归自我改进所需的研究能力提供了一个可衡量的、可审计的测试平台。我们在https://github.com/evolvent-ai/RSIBench-Data上开源了我们的代码。

articles.title: AI's Capability in Assisting Scientific Research in Physics, Astrophysics, and Cosmology II: Project Planning and Proposal Evaluation

authors.name: Kateryna Vovk
authors.affiliation: ChatGPT, Claude, and DeepSeek; mid-2025 models, used with their default tool access

articles.abstract: We investigate how well large language models (LLMs) can assist scientific project planning and proposal evaluation. One-page project plans were independently generated for eight expert-conceived research projects in physics, astrophysics, and cosmology by human researchers and three contemporary LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, and DeepSeek; mid-2025 models, used with their default tool access). The resulting 32 proposals were blindly evaluated by four human reviewers and two newer frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.8 and ChatGPT Pro 5.5) using a four-aspect evaluation rubric. Reviewers were also asked to identify whether each proposal was written by a human or an AI. Human reviewers rated human- and AI-written proposals similarly overall, whereas both AI reviewers scored AI-written proposals about one point higher (on a five-point scale) than human-written proposals. Human reviewers correctly identified human- and AI-written proposals 72% and 79% of the time, respectively, while both AI reviewers correctly classified all 32 proposals (100%). These results suggest that current LLMs can produce project plans comparable to human-written ones in the eyes of human reviewers, but that AI reviewers show a systematic preference for AI-generated proposals. Our results suggest caution when deploying LLMs widely in proposal preparation and evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 人工智能在物理、天体物理学和宇宙学研究中协助能力II：项目规划与提案评估
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在科学项目规划和提案评估方面的辅助能力。由人类研究人员和三种当代大型语言模型（ChatGPT、Claude和DeepSeek；2025年中模型，使用其默认工具访问）独立生成了八项由专家构思的物理学、天体物理学和宇宙学研究项目的单页项目计划。产生的32份提案由四位人类审稿人和两款更新的前沿大型语言模型（Claude Opus 4.8和ChatGPT Pro 5.5）采用四维度评估标准进行盲法评估。审稿人还被要求判断每份提案是由人类还是人工智能撰写的。人类审稿人对人类撰写和人工智能撰写的提案总体评分相似，而人工智能审稿人给人工智能撰写的提案评分比人类撰写的提案高约1分（在5分制量表上）。人类审稿人分别有72%和79%的准确率正确识别人类撰写和人工智能撰写的提案，而人工智能审稿人正确分类了所有32份提案（100%）。这些结果表明，当前的大型语言模型在人类审稿人眼中可以生成与人类撰写相当的项目计划，但人工智能审稿人对人工智能生成的提案表现出系统性的偏好。我们的研究结果提示在提案准备和评估中广泛部署大型语言模型时需谨慎。

articles.title: Stemma: Induced Decision Regions Reveal LLM Provenance
articles.abstract: LLM provenance testing asks whether a suspect LLM belongs to the same lineage as a source. Existing black-box methods largely infer this relationship from response-level characteristics, but these characteristics may shift under adaptation or deployment even when the underlying meaning remains unchanged, weakening the reliability of provenance evidence. To address this limitation, we introduce induced decision regions by mapping open-ended outputs into a finite decision space, thereby abstracting away surface-form variation and reframing provenance testing as measuring the inheritance of decision regions. Empirical analysis shows that the source's induced regions are preserved more strongly in related models than in unrelated models. Building on this signal, we propose Stemma, a practical black-box LLM fingerprinting method that operationalises stability, robustness, and specificity as complementary probe-selection principles for reliably estimating induced decision region inheritance. Across 770 source-suspect pairs drawn from 56 public checkpoints and spanning diverse model-weight transformations, Stemma achieves 0.967 AUC and 87.8% TPR at 1% FPR, substantially outperforming four representative baselines. It further achieves 0.995 AUC and 93.5% TPR at 1% FPR on 1,260 pairs covering 91 deployment instances, demonstrating robustness to diverse inference-time deployment settings.
articles.titleCn: 图灵机：诱导决策区域揭示大型语言模型来源
articles.abstractCn: LLM来源测试旨在判断一个可疑的LLM是否与某个源模型属于同一谱系。现有的黑盒方法主要从响应级别的特征来推断这种关系，但这些特征在适应或部署过程中可能会发生变化，即使底层含义保持不变，这削弱了来源证据的可靠性。为了解决这一局限性，我们通过将开放式输出映射到一个有限决策空间中，引入了诱导决策区域，从而抽象化了表层形式的变化，并将来源测试重新定义为衡量决策区域继承性的问题。实证分析表明，在相关模型中，源的诱导区域比在不相关模型中保留得更强烈。基于这一信号，我们提出了Stemma，这是一种实用的黑盒LLM指纹识别方法，它将稳定性、鲁棒性和特异性作为补充的探针选择原则，以可靠地估计诱导决策区域的继承性。在从56个公共检查点中抽取的770对源-可疑模型中，跨越了多样化的模型权重转换，Stemma在1% FPR下实现了0.967 AUC和87.8% TPR，显著优于四个代表性基线。它进一步在涵盖91个部署实例的1260对模型中，在1% FPR下实现了0.995 AUC和93.5% TPR，展示了其在多样化的推理时间部署环境中的鲁棒性。

articles.title: Shieldstral
articles.abstract: We introduce Shieldstral, a 3B-parameter policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier that matches or outperforms models nearly 7$\times$ its size on text safety benchmarks and sets a new state of the art on multimodal safety classification. Shieldstral formulates content moderation as a binary question-answering task. This simple formulation unifies diverse moderation tasks into a single yes/no problem, enabling heterogeneous safety datasets with divergent taxonomies to be consolidated under one training framework. We present the data construction recipe, covering curation and generation of approximately 54.1M samples and a fine-grained evaluation set to evaluate policy adaptability. Together, these enable a small adaptive model to match or outperform much larger models.
articles.titleCn: 盾星兽
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Shieldstral，一种3B参数的策略自适应多模态安全分类器，它在文本安全基准测试中的表现与近7倍大小的模型相当或更优，并在多模态安全分类领域设立了新的技术标杆。Shieldstral将内容审核表述为一个二进制问答任务。这种简单的表述将多样化的审核任务统一为一个简单的“是/否”问题，使得具有不同分类体系的异构安全数据集能够在统一的训练框架下整合。我们提出了数据构建方案，涵盖了约5410万样本的收集和生成，以及用于评估策略适应性的细粒度评估集。这些方案共同使得小型自适应模型能够与远大于自身的模型相媲美甚至超越。

articles.title: AngelSpec: Towards Real-World High Performance Inference with Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference without changing the target distribution, but no single drafting structure performs best across real-world workloads. Autoregressive multi-token prediction (MTP) is a lightweight, stable proposal mechanism, whereas block-parallel diffusion amortizes drafting latency over much longer candidate sequences; the better choice depends strongly on the output distribution. We present AngelSpec, a unified training framework for MTP and block-parallel speculative decoding that addresses this heterogeneity at three levels. At the training level, rather than fitting one universal drafter to a uniform data mixture, we co-specialize structure and data: the MTP drafter is trained on diverse conversational data for high-entropy open-ended chat, and the block-diffusion drafter on code and mathematics data for longer predictable continuations. At the architecture level, we propose DFly, a block-diffusion framework combining a hybrid target-conditioning backbone with a predecessor-conditioned autoregressive head, improving target-feature utilization and intra-block dependency modeling while keeping generation parallel. At the inference level, both acceptance length and verification cost vary with domain, request, online load, and hardware, so DFly treats verification as a shared batch-level resource: it reallocates compute toward high-confidence prefixes across requests and combines expected utility with a profiled cost model to adapt verification depth online. Across the Hy3 series, DFly raises the average accepted length on Hy3-A21B by roughly 30% and attains the highest average throughput at every tested concurrency from 4 to 64, a 1.98-2.40x speedup over autoregressive decoding and 10.5-11.8% higher throughput than DFlash. We release AngelSpec to support training and extending these methods.
articles.titleCn: AngelSpec：迈向基于推测解码的现实世界高性能推理
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码在不改变目标分布的情况下加速了大型语言模型的推理，但没有任何单一起草结构在真实工作负载中表现最佳。自回归多标记预测（MTP）是一种轻量级、稳定的提议机制，而块并行扩散将起草延迟分摊到更长的候选序列上；更好的选择取决于输出分布。我们提出了AngelSpec，一个用于MTP和块并行推测解码的统一训练框架，该框架在三个层次上解决了这种异质性。在训练层面，我们没有将一个通用的起草者拟合到均匀的数据混合中，而是共同专业化结构和数据：MTP起草者基于多样化的对话数据训练，用于高熵开放式聊天，块扩散起草者基于代码和数学数据训练，用于更长的可预测延续。在架构层面，我们提出了DFly，一个结合了混合目标调节主干和前驱条件化自回归头的块扩散框架，在保持生成并行性的同时，提高了目标特征利用率和块内依赖建模。在推理层面，接受长度和验证成本随领域、请求、在线负载和硬件而变化，因此DFly将验证视为共享的批处理级资源：它将计算重新分配到跨请求的高置信度前缀，并结合预期效用与一个分析成本模型来在线调整验证深度。在Hy3系列中，DFly将Hy3-A21B的平均接受长度提高了约30%，并在4到64的每个测试并发级别上达到了最高的平均吞吐量，比自回归解码快1.98-2.40倍，比DFlash高10.5-11.8%。我们发布了AngelSpec以支持这些方法的训练和扩展。

articles.title: Evaluation of Adversarial Robustness in Arabic Language Models
articles.abstract: The emergence of the recent outstanding capabilities of Arabic Language Models has opened doors for exposing their vulnerabilities. One of the major security risks associated with such Natural Language Processing models is adversarial attacks. These attacks can deceive the model into the wrong prediction, raising critical model security and safety concerns. This study aims to assess the robustness of five state-of-the-art Arabic Language Models under a distinct set of Arabic adversarial attacks applied at various levels of granularity and using different example generation strategies. We also explore a defense technique based on adversarial training to enhance model robustness. The results show that insertion of diacritics can reduce the accuracy of some models by 92% while maintaining a low perturbation distance. For word-level attacks, manipulating Arabic conjunctions preserves high semantic similarity scores, low perturbation distance, and leads to an accuracy degradation of up to 58%. For sentence-level attacks, paraphrasing proves its effectiveness by an average reduction of 76% in the victim models' performance. While adversarial training improves overall resilience, with MARBERT being the most robust and AraBERT showing the greatest relative gains, challenges persist, particularly against character-level noise. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of current defense strategies in morphologically rich languages like Arabic.
articles.titleCn: 阿拉伯语言模型对抗鲁棒性的评估
articles.abstractCn: 阿拉伯语言模型近期展现出的卓越能力为揭示其脆弱性提供了契机。与这类自然语言处理模型相关的主要安全风险之一是对抗性攻击。这些攻击能够误导模型做出错误预测，引发模型安全性和可靠性方面的重大问题。本研究旨在评估五个最先进的阿拉伯语言模型在一系列不同粒度级别和采用不同示例生成策略的阿拉伯对抗性攻击下的鲁棒性。我们还探索了一种基于对抗性训练的防御技术，以增强模型的鲁棒性。结果表明，在保持低扰动距离的同时，添加变音符号可以降低某些模型的准确率高达92%。在词级攻击中，操纵阿拉伯连词能够保持较高的语义相似度得分、较低的扰动距离，并导致准确率下降高达58%。在句级攻击中，释义通过平均降低受害者模型性能76%来证明其有效性。虽然对抗性训练提高了整体韧性，其中MARBERT最为鲁棒，AraBERT显示出最大的相对收益，但挑战依然存在，特别是在字符级噪声方面。这些发现突出了当前防御策略在形态丰富的语言（如阿拉伯语）中的潜力和局限性。

articles.title: WorkSurface-Bench: Benchmarking Enterprise Agents on Multi-Surface Knowledge Routing
articles.abstract: Enterprise agents often need to integrate heterogeneous knowledge sources: documents for narrative facts, tables for computation, and dependency graphs for file relationships. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate retrieval or tool use without distinguishing whether an agent first selects the appropriate knowledge sources. We introduce WorkSurface-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating this capability as surface routing. It contains 1,151 atomic tasks derived from persona-scoped Workspace-Bench-Lite workspaces, spanning document, table, graph, and cross-surface questions. Its reference answers are auditable: table answers are reproduced through executed DuckDB queries, document answers are grounded in verified text spans, and graph answers are traced to source dependency annotations. We evaluate four model backbones across six controlled agent settings, yielding 27,624 protocol-error-free trajectories. Under gold-constrained tool access, agents achieve 98.7-99.8 Route F1, while Answer remains only 56.1-75.3 percent, showing that correct surface selection is necessary but insufficient for task completion. Matched interventions further show that surface hints improve Answer for three of four models, whereas removing irrelevant tools primarily improves routing and efficiency. In an independent three-annotator audit, all 200 sampled tasks pass all six quality criteria by majority vote, with 192 receiving unanimous judgments on every criterion. We release the dataset, construction pipeline, scoring code, and agent harness at https://github.com/haolpku/WorkSurface-Bench.
articles.titleCn: WorkSurface-Bench：在多表面知识路由上对企业代理进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 企业代理通常需要整合异构知识源：用于叙述性事实的文档、用于计算的表格以及用于文件关系的依赖图。现有基准通常评估检索或工具使用，而未区分代理是否首先选择合适的知识源。我们引入 WorkSurface-Bench，这是一个用于评估该能力的基准，将其称为表面路由。它包含 1,151 个原子任务，源自 persona 范围内的 Workspace-Bench-Lite 工作空间，涵盖文档、表格、图和跨表面问题。其参考答案可审计：表格答案通过执行的 DuckDB 查询生成，文档答案基于经过验证的文本片段，图答案可追溯到源依赖注释。我们在六个受控代理设置下评估了四种模型主干，产生了 27,624 条无协议错误的轨迹。在金约束工具访问下，代理实现 98.7-99.8 的路由 F1，而答案仅为 56.1-75.3%，表明正确选择表面是完成任务必要但不充分的条件。匹配干预进一步表明，表面提示对四分之三的模型提高了答案质量，而移除无关工具主要提升了路由和效率。在独立的三个标注者审计中，所有 200 个抽样的任务在多数票通过所有六个质量标准，其中 192 个在所有标准上获得一致判断。我们发布了数据集、构建流程、评分代码和代理框架，地址为 https://github.com/haolpku/WorkSurface-Bench。

articles.title: SpeechLLM Meets Federated Learning for End-to-End ASR: English and Italian Case Studies
articles.abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving training of automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems across distributed data sources, yet its application to large-scale speech language models (SpeechLLMs) remains unexplored. This paper presents the first systematic study of federated training for SpeechLLM-based end-to-end ASR systems. We design a communication-efficient federated optimization strategy tailored to the unique challenges of SpeechLLM architectures, addressing high-dimensional parameter spaces, gradient communication overhead, and computational constraints in distributed settings. Through extensive empirical evaluation on monolingual ASR tasks in English and Italian, we demonstrate the effectiveness and stability of our federated approach compared to centralized training baselines across diverse acoustic conditions and speaking styles. Additionally, we conduct a comprehensive ablation study analyzing the impact of different speech encoder architectures on monolingual English ASR performance within the federated framework, providing insights into optimal model configurations for decentralized training. Our results achieve competitive word error rates while reducing communication costs, establishing practical foundations for federated SpeechLLM deployment in real-world multilingual scenarios.
articles.comment: Accepted at the 2nd International Conference on Federated Learning and Intelligent Computing Systems (FLICS2026)
articles.titleCn: SpeechLLM 结合联邦学习实现端到端语音识别：英语和意大利语案例研究
articles.abstractCn: 联邦学习（FL）能够实现跨分布式数据源的自动语音识别（ASR）系统隐私保护训练，但其在大规模语音语言模型（SpeechLLM）上的应用仍待探索。本文首次系统地研究了基于SpeechLLM的端到端ASR系统的联邦训练方法。我们设计了一种针对SpeechLLM架构独特挑战的通信高效联邦优化策略，解决了高维参数空间、梯度通信开销以及分布式环境下的计算限制问题。通过对英语和意大利语单语ASR任务进行广泛的实证评估，我们证明了与集中式训练基线相比，我们的联邦方法在多种声学条件和说话风格下均表现出有效性和稳定性。此外，我们进行了全面的消融研究，分析了不同语音编码器架构在联邦框架下单语英语ASR性能的影响，为去中心化训练中的最佳模型配置提供了见解。我们的结果在实现具有竞争力的字错误率的同时降低了通信成本，为联邦SpeechLLM在真实多语言场景中的部署奠定了实际基础。

articles.title: AI's Capability in Assisting Scientific Research in Physics, Astrophysics, and Cosmology I: Literature Review

authors.name: Veena Krishnaraj
authors.affiliation: ChatGPT-4o, ChatGPT Deep Research, and Gemini

authors.name: Adrian E. Bayer
authors.affiliation: real papers with one or more incorrect fields

authors.name: Linda Blot
authors.affiliation: title, author, year, journal, DOI, or link

articles.abstract: We investigate how well large language models (LLMs) can assist with literature reviews for scientific research. We perform a controlled study of eight expert-conceived research projects across the areas of physics, astrophysics, and cosmology. Each project has a defined background and goal, and human experts and AI prompters are asked to perform identical literature review tasks in parallel. We compare the relevant literature selected by humans with that selected by mid-2025 LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, ChatGPT Deep Research, and Gemini). We find the overlap between human- and AI-selected references to be small ($<$6\%), indicating that AI models do not yet reproduce a competent expert search on their own, though they have the potential to complement literature searches by humans. We then assess the reliability and completeness of AI-generated candidate references, distinguishing two types of hallucination: fabrications (references to nonexistent papers) and metadata mismatches (real papers with one or more incorrect fields). We find that while fabricated references make up 3\% of the AI-generated references, 64\% are real papers with at least one incorrect field (title, author, year, journal, DOI, or link), indicating that the mid-2025 models require systematic verification. However, the performance is significantly improved for the 2026 model ChatGPT Pro 5.5, with a single-project test showing zero fabrication or metadata mismatches.
articles.titleCn: 人工智能在物理学、天体物理学和宇宙学研究中协助能力：文献综述
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在科学研究中辅助文献综述方面的能力。我们对物理、天体物理和宇宙学领域的八个由专家构思的研究项目进行了控制研究。每个项目都有明确的背景和目标，人类专家和AI提示者被要求并行执行相同的文献综述任务。我们将人类选择的文献与2025年年中LLM（ChatGPT-4o、ChatGPT深度研究、Gemini）选择的文献进行比较。我们发现人类与AI选择参考文献的重合度很小（小于6%），表明AI模型尚未能够独立复制合格专家的搜索结果，尽管它们有潜力补充人类文献搜索。然后，我们评估了AI生成候选参考文献的可靠性和完整性，区分了两种类型的幻觉：伪造（引用不存在的论文）和元数据不匹配（真实论文有一个或多个错误字段）。我们发现，虽然伪造参考文献占AI生成参考文献的3%，但64%是至少有一个错误字段（标题、作者、年份、期刊、DOI或链接）的真实论文，表明2025年年中的模型需要系统验证。然而，2026年模型ChatGPT Pro 5.5的性能显著提高，单个项目测试显示零伪造或元数据不匹配。

articles.title: MyMentorLLM: A psychotherapy GenAI environment with multimodal voice/text patients, trainees and experts for deliberate practice

authors.name: Alessandro Grecucci
authors.affiliation: with major depressive, generalised anxiety or borderline personality disorder

articles.abstract: Psychotherapists need repeated training and supervision by experts; however, scalability is problematic. Here we present MyMentorLLM, a multimodal voice- and text-based simulation environment for deliberate practice, used to generate 2,100 complete Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) training sessions. Each session links a DSM-5-TR-grounded patient (with major depressive, generalised anxiety or borderline personality disorder), a therapist-in-training and an expert supervisor. As an initial implementation, we adopted CBT because its structured procedures and competency-based supervision facilitate standardised simulation and evaluation. Sessions were analysed for emotional dynamics, therapeutic competence and diagnostic accuracy. Simulated patients expressed disorder-congruent emotional profiles, which trainee therapists mirrored as in real human counselling. The quality of supervision differed across LLMs: while most models overestimated trainees' competences, native speech-to-speech was closest to human scores. Supervisors' feedback led to better diagnoses in simulated psychotherapists in 5 out of 7 LLMs, and symptom identification accuracy increased with model size. This work shows that simulation of deliberate practice is possible for CBT training, although patient fidelity, calibration of supervisors, and harmful feedback should be evaluated together.
articles.titleCn: MyMentorLLM：一个用于心理治疗的生成式人工智能环境，包含多模态语音/文本患者、学员和专家，用于刻意练习
articles.abstractCn: 心理治疗师需要专家的持续培训和监督；然而，可扩展性存在问题。我们在此介绍MyMentorLLM，这是一个基于语音和文本的多模态模拟环境，用于刻意练习，用于生成2,100个完整的认知行为疗法（CBT）培训课程。每个课程将一个基于DSM-5-TR的患者（患有重度抑郁症、广泛性焦虑症或边缘性人格障碍）、一个正在接受培训的治疗师和一个专家监督者联系起来。作为初步实施，我们采用了CBT，因为其结构化程序和基于能力的监督促进了标准化的模拟和评估。课程被分析用于情绪动态、治疗能力和诊断准确性。模拟患者表现出与疾病相符的情绪特征，而实习治疗师则像在真实人类咨询中一样模仿这些特征。监督质量在不同的LLM之间存在差异：虽然大多数模型高估了实习生的能力，但原生语音到语音的模型最接近人类评分。在7个LLM中的5个中，治疗师的反馈导致了模拟心理治疗师更好的诊断，并且随着模型规模的增加，症状识别的准确性也随之提高。这项工作表明，对于CBT培训，刻意练习的模拟是可能的，尽管患者保真度、监督者的校准和有害反馈应一起进行评估。

articles.title: Localized Adaptation Reveals Distinct Learning Signatures in Transformers

authors.name: Brian Scassellati
authors.affiliation: lexical binding, factual association, behavioral policy learning, causal mapping, and procedural reasoning

articles.abstract: Transformer adaptation is typically distributed across model depth, even when the intended change is narrow. We investigate how adaptation site shapes what a model learns, how well that learning generalizes, and how selectively it is applied. We introduce a controlled benchmark spanning five objectives (lexical binding, factual association, behavioral policy learning, causal mapping, and procedural reasoning) and define each objective's "adaptation geometry" as its profile of acquisition, transfer, and boundedness under full-stack and early-, middle-, or late-layer LoRA. The objectives exhibit distinct geometries. Lexical binding favors early-layer adaptation for acquisition and boundedness but requires broader updates for transfer; factual association favors later layers among localized adapters; behavioral learning separates late-layer action acquisition from middle-layer policy gating; and causal and procedural transfer benefit most from middle- or full-stack adaptation. These patterns largely persist under parameter-matched controls, and most corresponding directional contrasts replicate across five model families. These findings establish adaptation site as a key design variable for controlling what models learn, generalize, and leave unchanged.

articles.titleCn: 局部适应揭示了Transformer中独特的学习特征
articles.abstractCn: Transformer自适应通常分布在模型深度上，即使预期的改变范围很窄。我们研究了自适应位置如何影响模型学习的内容、学习效果以及选择性的应用方式。我们引入了一个涵盖五个目标（词汇绑定、事实关联、行为策略学习、因果映射和程序推理）的受控基准，并将每个目标在完整堆栈和早期、中期或晚期LoRA下的获取、迁移和有界性特征定义为该目标的“自适应几何形状”。这些目标表现出不同的几何形状。词汇绑定倾向于早期层自适应以实现获取和有界性，但需要更广泛的更新以实现迁移；事实关联倾向于局部适配器中的后期层；行为学习将后期层动作获取与中期层策略门控分离；因果和程序迁移则从中期或完整堆栈自适应中受益最大。这些模式在参数匹配的控制下基本保持一致，并且大多数对应的方向性对比在五个模型系列中都能得到验证。这些发现表明，自适应位置是控制模型学习内容、泛化效果以及保持不变性的关键设计变量。

articles.title: Instruction-based Image Editing: A Survey on Data, Models, Evaluation, and Applications
articles.abstract: Instruction-based Image Editing (IIE) aims to transform a given image into a new one based on textual instructions. Advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have accelerated progress toward practical ``one-sentence image editing" systems. This survey presents a systematic taxonomy and comprehensive review of IIE research, structured around five core dimensions: (1) task definition and hierarchical categorization of editing operations, (2) methodologies for training data construction, (3) architectural evolution from GAN-based to diffusion and autoregressive paradigms, (4) standardized evaluation metrics and benchmark development, and (5) introduction of commercial solutions. Our analysis shows critical technological milestones across model generations. We further propose a Comprehensive, in-Depth, and Diagnostic benchmark for IIE task (CDD-IIE Bench), which can rigorously assess the multiple aspects of model performance. Through empirical comparisons of open-source solutions, we highlight their respective capabilities and limitations. Finally, we discuss future research directions to advance the field.
articles.titleCn: 基于指令的图像编辑：关于数据、模型、评估和应用的研究综述
articles.abstractCn: 指令式图像编辑（IIE）旨在根据文本指令将给定图像转换为新的图像。大型语言模型（LLMs）和视觉语言模型（VLMs）的进步加速了实用“一句话图像编辑”系统的研发进程。本综述系统地梳理和全面回顾了IIE研究，围绕五个核心维度展开：（1）任务定义和编辑操作的层次分类，（2）训练数据构建方法，（3）从基于GAN到扩散和自回归范式的架构演进，（4）标准化评估指标和基准开发，（5）商业解决方案的引入。我们的分析展示了跨模型代际的关键技术里程碑。我们进一步提出了用于IIE任务的全面、深入和诊断性基准（CDD-IIE Bench），该基准能够严格评估模型性能的多个方面。通过开源解决方案的实证比较，我们突出了它们各自的能力和局限性。最后，我们讨论了未来研究方向以推动该领域的发展。

articles.title: AIriskEval-edu Demo: Auditing of Pedagogical Risks in Educational Explanations
articles.abstract: We present AIriskEval-edu Demo, a platform that audits the pedagogical quality of instructional explanations and provides explainable audit results. The platform evaluates an explanation against a rubric covering five dimensions of pedagogical risk: factual accuracy, depth and completeness, focus and relevance, student-level appropriateness, and ideological bias. For each dimension, it returns a binary decision and a confidence score. Detected risks also include a natural-language rationale and, except for Depth and Completeness, a localized evidence span. The platform integrates GPT-5.5 through an external API and a self-hosted Llama 3.1 8B evaluator that runs on consumer-grade GPUs. The local evaluator is fine-tuned on AIriskEval-edu, a dataset of K-12 instructional explanations with risk and explainability annotations. The platform operates in two modes: in AI mode, both evaluators assess stored explanations generated under six simulated teacher profiles, each representing a distinct pedagogical behavior and potential risk; in human mode, the local evaluator audits user-written explanations in real time. The local evaluator outperforms GPT-5.5 on most reported metrics, offering educational institutions a practical way to keep audited content within their own infrastructure.
